title: Juicy Indulgent German Soybeans Stir-fry
description: A savory and indulgent vegetarian dish featuring caramelized soya beans for a unique twist on traditional soybean dishes, perfect as a side or main course.
instructions: Soak the soybeans overnight in water.
Drain and rinse the soaked soybeans. Add them to a pot with enough water to cover them, salt, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for about 20-30 minutes until tender but still chewy.
While cooking the beans, chop the onions finely, mince the garlic and ginger.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chopped onions and sauté until translucent. Then add minced garlic and ginger to continue frying for about 2 minutes.
Fold in cooked soybeans and red pepper flakes. Pour brown sugar into the pan and stir gently, allowing it to caramelize slightly.
Season with salt and pepper according to taste. Serve hot as a side dish or main course.
